lines.text: I got left on read again.

data.define: When someone sees your message but doesn't reply.

example.text: I got left on read again.

misuse.text: Don't say 'left on read' about a book.
misuse.why: It means no reply after reading.

publish.title: What does "left on read" mean?
publish.value: Left on read = Read but not answered. Example: "I got left on read again." (casual English, US).
